problem.title: Key-door maze
problem.summary: Reach the exit under limited energy and time. The key-and-gate route saves energy, direct routes save time, and the exact frontier preserves four tradeoffs that one score would hide.

instances.label: Micro

instances.label: Showcase

instances.label: Stress

strategies.label: Fewest moves
strategies.description: Breadth-first search: the shortest sequence, whatever it costs.
